platform.note: Darwin-only privacy and exclusive-publication backends; other platforms fail closed.

manifestDevelopRecheck.method: git cat-file --batch on origin/develop; sha256 per path compared with the value recorded from the team ref
manifestDevelopRecheck.note: squash 병합 후에도 261개 경로의 내용 해시가 팀 ref와 동일하다. 팀은 develop만으로 전량 재현할 수 있다.

inputProvenance.digestComparison: per-path blobSha1 and sha256 compared against the published manifest; 3/3 matched
inputProvenance.notAcceptSubstitute: manifest is proposal_for_pm_review with publicationApproval=not_obtained and postPublishRecheckDone=false; it does not substitute for issue 120 acceptance.

sourceAvailabilityDrift.observed: snapshot records the three target paths as local_unpublished (develop=false); the published manifest records them as presentOnTeamRef=true with matching digests
sourceAvailabilityDrift.resolution: The snapshot was not used as current availability; availability was decided by blob digest comparison against the published manifest.

boundary.writeGate: configure() raises _StagingOwnershipUnproven before the first credential write when the descriptor-to-entry binding cannot be established.
boundary.publicationGate: The trusted-parent precondition is re-verified, the ownership evidence is re-derived, and the pinned directory must hold exactly the entries this run acquired - each still resolving to the file identity it was acquired under - before the exclusive rename. An entry injected after the last write, or an acquired name unlinked and recreated with other bytes, stops publication; the run's own credentials are rolled back and the foreign entry is preserved for manual cleanup.
boundary.rollback: Exact-owned: only acquired file identities are unlinked, and the directory is rmdir'd only while it is still the proven inode.
boundary.unauthenticatedWindow: The create-to-open window is not authenticated by pathname; the trusted parent (0700, current-user-owned, no additional ACL) is the precondition that excludes other principals. A same-account actor racing that window is not detectable and is not claimed.
boundary.wasPreviousState: staging_ownership_proven was hardcoded False and gated only rollback rmdir; credential writes and publication were not gated on ownership.

checks.note: 24 pre-existing tests plus 8 new boundary tests.

checks.command: mutation matrix over the five gates

mutations.mutation: publication ownership gate reduced to a no-op
publication entry-set gate reduced to a no-op
per-entry file identity comparison inside the entry-set gate removed

checks.note: Each gate is load-bearing: removing it makes at least one boundary test fail. Every kill counted here is a behavioural test that observes directories, files or exceptions; a source-digest assertion is not counted as a kill.

checks.command: independent supervisor probe: inject a foreign entry after the last credential write, before the publication gate
checks.note: Against the previous commit (4a3f727) this probe published the injected entry as private configuration and returned success. The same probe against this commit refuses with _CleanupIncomplete, publishes nothing, rolls back the run's own credentials and leaves the injected entry for manual cleanup. This is the regression the entry-set gate closes.

separateFrom.note: The 32 tests here are a separate total from the pre-existing Python 24 and the Voice 89 totals named in issue 151.

failedOrUnrun.reason: Predecessor candidate handoff was consumed; acceptance of issue 120 is a separate PM decision and was not performed here.
Exclusive no-replace publication and descriptor ACL checks are Darwin-only; other platforms stay fail-closed.
Candidate phase writes are isolated proposals (canonicalWriteAllowed=false). Canonical application is a PM decision.
No service was started and no external package was installed; verification is local-fixture only.

successorHandoff.note: Consumes the accept-phase proof before real microphone/PTT work; Python24/Voice89 totals do not substitute.
Consumes the accept-phase proof before delivering the service; failed or unverified backends stay fail-closed.

runRecord.claimRelease: Held until the candidate artifact is returned to PM, or released on abort with notice.

digestScope.note: The candidate changes are uncommitted on the claim branch; baseCommit is the branch point, not the content being returned.
